rationale: Price is sitting exactly on session VWAP ($23.09) with the auto-enforced invalidation only ~$0.05 below, so the original "VWAP defense / low-volume pullback" thesis is at its decision point but not yet broken. The last candle did print a marginal new low on the heaviest volume of the sequence and price is just under the 9-EMA ($23.15), which tempers the edge, but shorting right into VWAP support after a strong rally off the $22.25 low is not compelling and closing a -0.30% position with a defined stop in place is premature. Holding keeps the favorable asymmetry (risk ~$0.05 to stop vs. ~$0.41 to target) intact while the tight invalidation manages the downside.
